$comment: Player-facing labels use the site's racing terms in Title Case (Throttle, Brake, Steering Left / Right...), as ReCarbon's own Settings rows do since M8; they rename, never re-map. Hand-written overlay on controls.generated.json (docs/PLAN.md §2): what each Xbox control does in the game, per mode, with a status and its evidence. Ids must exist in the generated file; the build fails otherwise. Never upgrade a status here without the evidence that does it. An action with no label is shown as 'to verify' and never named.

keyboard.evidence: tests/key_map_test.cpp (24 controls, roles, bits), tests/settings_keys_test.cpp (defaults and [keys] names), tests/key_names_test.cpp

presets.evidence: tests/profiles_test.cpp: Default, shown as WASD, is the settings' defaults (the former WASD preset merged into it, 2026-10-24); Arrows is the approved table in full, 22 keys with no key on two controls; each preset's keys resolve to the intended controls only. Passed on the M5 (2026-10-24).

controller.evidence: tests/pad_map_test.cpp (the 14-button baseline), tests/profiles_test.cpp (the default controller profile)

virtualController.evidence: SDL virtual-controller runs (RECARBON_VIRTUAL_PAD): menus, hot-unplug with DETACH/ATTACH (FEASIBILITY §6a), and controller rebinding in Settings > Controller, persisting after a restart (ROADMAP M8). Automated evidence for the input path, not proof that a physical controller works.

physicalController.evidence: Deferred, not verified (ROADMAP, the user's decision of 2026-10-23): no physical controller has been hand-tested, and controller rebinding hasn't been tried on hardware.

paddles.evidence: runtime/hid/pad_map.h has no SDL paddle or MISC entry, and nothing in runtime/ reads them. If a pad's own firmware remaps a paddle to another button, it acts as that button.

driving.label: Throttle
driving.evidence: M8 controls audit (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24; the controls handoff of 2026-10-24): driven on the keyboard in hand tests 1, 3 and 4 (free-roam and a won career race), on the WASD keys (the Default profile).

driving.label: Brake / Reverse
driving.evidence: Braking: M8 controls audit (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24), seen in hand tests 1, 3 and 4, on the WASD keys (the Default profile). Reversing: virtual-controller check (2026-10-24) only, not yet by hand: held at a standstill, the HUD gear goes to R and the car backs up (0 > 7 > 25 mph).

driving.label: Steering Left
driving.evidence: M8 controls audit (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24; the controls handoff of 2026-10-24): steering seen in hand tests 1, 3 and 4, on the WASD keys (the Default profile).

driving.label: Steering Right
driving.evidence: M8 controls audit (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24; the controls handoff of 2026-10-24): steering seen in hand tests 1, 3 and 4, on the WASD keys (the Default profile).
No evidence yet of its action in a race. The virtual-controller sweep (2026-10-24, reference/M8_PLAN.md) showed no visible effect in a Quick Race; it waits for a hand test.

menu.label: Navigate
menu.evidence: Option text in settings.cpp: "The left stick pushed up (menus)." Unbound in the Arrows preset.

driving.evidence: No evidence yet of its action in a race. The virtual-controller sweep (2026-10-24, reference/M8_PLAN.md) showed no visible effect in a Quick Race; it waits for a hand test.

driving.label: Handbrake
driving.evidence: Space (A) worked as the handbrake by hand on the keyboard (reference/M7_ACCEPTANCE.md, M7.1, 2026-10-25), on the WASD keys (the Default profile), in a Quick Race on the MacBook Air M1 (race 3). The virtual-controller sweep (2026-10-24) showed no visible effect.

menu.label: Confirm
menu.evidence: M5 hand test 2 (2026-10-23): menu navigation with the keyboard, on the WASD keys (the Default profile). Also seen with the virtual controller (2026-10-24, reference/M8_PLAN.md).

driving.label: Nitrous
driving.evidence: Backspace (B) fired the nitrous by hand on the keyboard (reference/M7_ACCEPTANCE.md, M7.1, 2026-10-25), on the WASD keys (the Default profile), in a Quick Race on the MacBook Air M1, with the BONUS RX-8 and a full nitrous gauge (the stock RX-8 has none). An earlier Backspace press, during race 3's key sweep, didn't trigger nitrous; why isn't known.

menu.label: Back
menu.evidence: M5 hand test 2 (2026-10-23): menu navigation with the keyboard, on the WASD keys (the Default profile). Also seen with the virtual controller (2026-10-24, reference/M8_PLAN.md).

driving.label: Speedbreaker
driving.evidence: Left Shift (X) worked as Speedbreaker by hand on the keyboard (reference/M7_ACCEPTANCE.md, M7.1, 2026-10-25), on the WASD keys (the Default profile), in a Quick Race on the MacBook Air M1 (race 3). The virtual-controller sweep (2026-10-24) showed no visible effect.

No evidence yet of its action in a race. The virtual-controller sweep (2026-10-24, reference/M8_PLAN.md) showed no visible effect in a Quick Race, and Left Ctrl (Y) didn't trigger nitrous in a hand test (2026-10-25).

driving.label: Look Back
driving.evidence: Virtual-controller check (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24): scripted Quick Race on the M1 worker, Circuit, stock RX-8, manual gearbox, under about 35 mph; paired screenshots. While held the view faces backward; normal on release.

driving.label: Change Camera
driving.evidence: Virtual-controller check (reference/M8_PLAN.md, 2026-10-24): scripted Quick Race on the M1 worker, Circuit, stock RX-8, manual gearbox, under about 35 mph; paired screenshots. Each tap moves to the next camera, kept after release (near chase, far chase, bumper, hood, near chase). The tester also changed the camera by hand in a race on the keyboard (2026-10-25, reference/M7_ACCEPTANCE.md); which key wasn't recorded, so the status stays automated.

open.label: Open / Close Settings
open.detail: Any time, in game or in menus: Cmd+, (Command + Comma). Also F1 (Fn+F1 on a Mac keyboard, where F1 is the brightness key).

navigate.label: Navigate / Change Value
navigate.detail: Choose a row and change its value. On the Controls page, left and right pick the key slot (first or second key).

activate.label: Activate / Set Key
activate.detail: Dear ImGui's keyboard navigation: Space activates. On the Controls page it waits for the new key.
activate.evidence: runtime/ui/ui.cpp ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard; the footer legend "A: set key"

clearSlot.label: Clear Key Slot
clearSlot.detail: On the Controls page: sets the chosen slot to none.

resetControl.label: Reset Control
resetControl.detail: On the Controls page: both slots go back to their defaults.

close.label: Close / Back
close.detail: Also cancels the Quit Game confirmation.
